description: This is a code-behind file for an ASP.NET web page 'TakenCourses.aspx', containing server-side event handlers for button clicks that navigate to other pages within the 'OnlineExamSystem' web application.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: A code-behind class for the 'TakenCourses' ASP.NET web page, handling server-side events for navigation buttons.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently no additional logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Home' button click; transfers server to 'Dashboard.aspx'.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Profile' button click; transfers server to 'UserProfile.aspx'.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Leaderboard' button click; transfers server to 'Leaderboard.aspx'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the 'Logout' button click; transfers server to 'LoginPage.aspx'.
